blocks.text: Arithmetic operators hisaab ke basic (bunyadi) kaam karte hain: addition (jama, +), subtraction (minus karna, -), multiplication (zarb, *), division (taqseem, /), modulus (%, division ke baad bachne wala baqi), exponentiation (**, power) aur floor division (//, division ka sirf poora hissa). Neeche ka code dikhata hai ke Python mein yeh kaise istemal hote hain.

# Define variables
a = 10
b = 3
# Perform all arithmetic operations on these numeric variables and print results
print(a, "+", b, "=", a + b) # Output: 10+3=13
print(a, "*", b, " = ", a * b) # Output: 10 * 3 = 30
print(a, "/", b, " = ", a / b)
# Output: 10 / 3 = 3.3333333333333335
print(a, "//", b, " = ", a // b)
# Output: 10 // 3=3
print(a, "%", b, " = ", a % b)
# Output: 10 % 3 = 1
print(a, "**", b, " = ", a ** b)
# Output: 10**3= 1000

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"a = 10" aur "b = 3": do numbers jin par hisaab hoga. Har assignment alag line mein hai.
"a + b": addition (jama): 10 + 3 = 13.
"a * b": multiplication (zarb): 10 * 3 = 30.
"a / b": division (taqseem): 10 / 3 = 3.3333333333333335. / hamesha float deta hai; aakhri 5 computer ke decimal hisaab ki chhoti si kami hai.
"a // b": floor division: sirf poora hissa, 3.
"a % b": modulus: 10 ko 3 se taqseem karne par baqi 1.
"a ** b": exponentiation (power): 10 ki power 3 = 1000.
Dhyan dein: comment "all arithmetic operations" kehta hai magar subtraction (-) wali line program mein nahi hai. print mein " = " ke saath commas wale spaces bhi lagte hain, is liye kuch lines mein do spaces aate hain.
Output: "10 + 3 = 13", "10 * 3  =  30", "10 / 3  =  3.3333333333333335", "10 // 3  =  3", "10 % 3  =  1", "10 ** 3  =  1000".
Khud try karein: b = 4 kar ke Run karein: jawab 14, 40, 2.5, 2, 2 aur 10000 aayenge.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab doosri line a= 10 b= 3 ek hi line mein chhapti hai. Python mein yeh SyntaxError hai. Har assignment alag line mein likhein: a = 10 aur b = 3 (ya ek line mein a, b = 10, 3).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Asal output (a = 10, b = 3): 10 + 3 = 13; 10 * 3 = 30; 10 / 3 = 3.3333333333333335 (/ hamesha float deta hai); 10 // 3 = 3 (sirf poora hissa); 10 % 3 = 1 (baqi); 10 ** 3 = 1000 (10 ki power 3). Kitab subtraction (-) ka zikr karti hai magar code mein us ki line nahi; woh print(a, "-", b, " = ", a - b) hogi, jis ka nateeja 7 hai.
